verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing and entitlements layer that runs on Stripe, so checkout payment-method acceptance is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL or any local payment methods. Whatever Stripe itself supports underneath is a host-platform capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration
